summary: North Fork Pinnacle, Perry County, Arkansas: Ouachita National Forest lookout tower marked removed in 1965; a 2009 visitor post describes concrete remains at the summit.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Removal in 1965 rests on one page with no source of its own. The concrete remains and the old road come from one 2009 forum post by a visitor, which was not checked on the ground and is 17 years old; the story says so. The NGS listing has a second row for this mark coded NN; the story uses only the XX row (surface mark reported destroyed). The NGS 'about 115 feet tall' does not say whether it runs to the cab floor, so height_m (35.1) is the record's figure. No build date, staffing or access source found. AllTrails pages returned 403 and were not used. Brief status (gone) and agency (Ouachita National Forest) match the sources. Worth a check with the Ouachita National Forest before publishing.
